Uttamātherīgāthā Uttamā Verses of the Elder Uttamā

“Catukkhattuṁ pañcakkhattuṁ, Four or five times “Four times, five times, vihārā upanikkhamiṁ; I left my dwelling. I went outside. Aladdhā cetaso santiṁ, I had failed to find peace of heart, I had not attained peace of mind citte avasavattinī. or any control over my mind. and I had no power over the mind.

Sā bhikkhuniṁ upagacchiṁ, I approached a nun I approached a bhikkhunī yā me saddhāyikā ahu; in whom I had faith. whom I trusted. Sā me dhammamadesesi, She taught me the Dhamma: She taught me the Dhamma: khandhāyatanadhātuyo. the aggregates, sense fields, and elements. the khandhas, elements, and sense domains.

Tassā dhammaṁ suṇitvāna, When I had heard her teaching, I listened to her Dhamma, Yathā maṁ anusāsi sā; in accordance with her instructions, followed her instructions, Sattāhaṁ ekapallaṅkena, I sat cross-legged for seven days without moving, and sat cross-legged for seven days, Nisīdiṁ pītisukhasamappitā; given over to rapture and bliss. dedicated to bliss and happiness. Aṭṭhamiyā pāde pasāresiṁ, On the eighth day I stretched out my feet, On the eighth day I stretched out my feet, Tamokhandhaṁ padāliyā”ti. having shattered the mass of darkness. having destroyed this mass of darkness.”

… Uttamā therī …. The Elder Uttamā
